notes: New Tuning page (under Plasma StandAlone): a live scope of Power, electrode Temperature and Vacuum flow streamed from the Tip Charger's USB-to-RS232 port (the Power,Temp,Vac CSV). Three independently auto-scaled lines with a selectable time window, big current-value readouts, and a per-second delta on each - so you can adjust frequency/voltage and watch the response in real time.
